title: Harden startup initialization, improve retry, and add safe diagnostics

requirements.summary: Prevent unhandled startup initialization errors and surface real initialization failures (including access-control init) without trapping on missing admin token
acceptanceCriteria: Loading the draft URL no longer immediately shows the startup error screen on a healthy network.
If backend/agent/actor initialization fails, the error is captured (no unhandled promise rejection) and is available to display/log for debugging.
The app does not trap solely because an admin token is missing/empty; startup works without providing any admin token.

file_operations.description: Create a wrapper actor hook that composes the backend connection setup but adds: (1) explicit try/catch around actor creation and access-control initialization, (2) skipping access-control initialization when the admin token is missing/empty, (3) an exposed initialization error for the UI layer, and (4) a re-initialization trigger mechanism (e.g., attempt counter) to force a fresh actor boot. Ensure behavior aligns with the authorization component expectations for access-control initialization. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update queries that currently depend on useActor() to depend on the new useSafeActor() hook so that startup failures can be detected and surfaced consistently, and so query enabling reflects the safe actor readiness state.

Switch startup gating logic (AuthenticatedGate) to use the safe actor hook and display a startup error screen with the actual captured initialization/profile error rather than a generic failure state. Ensure actor initialization errors are not treated as a permanent stuck state and are visible for debugging.

requirements.summary: Make StartupErrorScreen Retry fully re-run startup by reinitializing actor and then refetching the profile
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Retry triggers a fresh actor initialization attempt and then re-runs the user profile fetch.
If the initial failure was transient (e.g., a temporary agent/replica error), Retry can recover without a hard refresh.
Retry does not require navigating away or clearing storage manually.

file_operations.description: Add a small orchestration hook used by startup gates to implement a single Retry action that (1) triggers a fresh actor initialization attempt (via the safe actor hook re-init trigger) and then (2) re-runs the current user profile query once the actor is ready.
Update StartupErrorScreen wiring so Retry calls the startup retry orchestrator (fresh actor init + profile refetch), rather than only refetching the profile.
Extend the component props to support a disabled/loading Retry state while a retry is in progress, to avoid double-submits and to reflect that a full startup re-attempt is underway.

requirements.summary: Change French startup/loading text to English
acceptanceCriteria: All loading states shown during app startup use English text (e.g., "Loading...").
No French strings remain in the startup gates (AuthGate/AuthenticatedGate) loading UI.

file_operations.description: Replace French startup loading copy (e.g., "Chargement...") with English equivalents (e.g., "Loading...") in both AuthGate and AuthenticatedGate loading UI.

requirements.summary: Add minimal, user-safe startup diagnostics with sanitized UI summary and console logging
acceptanceCriteria: When startup fails, the UI shows a short error summary (e.g., "Initialization failed" + a sanitized message).
No secret values (e.g., any admin token) are rendered to the screen or logged.
The console contains enough detail (stack/message) to debug the root cause.

file_operations.description: Add utilities to normalize unknown thrown values into an Error-like shape and to sanitize error messages for display/logging (redact any occurrences of secret/token-like parameters such as caffeineAdminToken/caffeineAdminToken-like patterns). Provide helpers for producing a compact user-safe summary and a console-safe detailed log payload.
Update the startup error UI to render a compact, user-safe error summary (sanitized) when present, while keeping the overall screen minimal and readable. Ensure no sensitive values are shown.

Pass captured startup errors (actor init error or profile query error) into StartupErrorScreen as sanitized summaries, and ensure the full (sanitized) error detail is always logged to the browser console when the startup error screen is shown.

Add global startup diagnostics handlers for window 'unhandledrejection' and 'error' that log sanitized details to the console (without rendering secrets), to prevent silent failures during boot from being missed.
